candidates.statement: Checkout 502s trace to inventory's redis.reserve_inventory failing with timeout/DependencyUnavailable, propagating 503 from inventory and 502 from order to gateway checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side metrics/logs not directly observed; gateway dependency metrics series empty. Root cause of redis timeout (saturation vs network) unconfirmed.

report.explanation: All four checkout requests return 502 after ~2s; traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts causing inventory 503 and order 502. Bounded candidate is redis-timeout; redis-side evidence still needed to confirm mechanism.
missing_evidence: Redis server-side metrics/logs (latency, connections, errors) to confirm redis as failing dependency
Inventory service logs/traces to confirm redis timeout origin and duration
Gateway dependency_operations metrics (currently empty) for dependency outcome rates
